description: Re-reads a lead-source sender's past emails so each becomes a lead, as saving a sender as New leads does. One bounded pass per call: pass next_before from the response back as before until it comes back null. Changes nothing that was already read (the run's state is the database). domain is the sender's own email domain or number; before is the cursor from the previous pass. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: reread_lead_source_backlog
title: Re-read a lead source's past emails
